name: LLMEval2
description: LLMEval2 is the largest and most diverse English evaluation benchmark for LLM evaluators, comprising 15 tasks, 8 abilities, and 2,553 samples, designed to assess the quality of LLM-generated responses aligned with human preferences.
reputation: A niche benchmark for evaluating LLM judges/evaluators, mainly of interest to researchers studying automated evaluation rather than a broad general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Benchmark designed for evaluating LLM evaluators with multiple tasks and abilities; enables improved agreement with human evaluation.
